# ScriptClientWorld

*Client*

World loaded by the client, from `c.getWorld()` in client scripts.

## Methods

### getPlayers {#getplayers}

::: member

Lists the players this client sees in its world. Currently it fails with a `ClassCastException` while other players are loaded, so it works only alone.

**Returns** `List<ScriptClientPlayer>` — new list of the players

:::
